map.依据造影剂显影情况评估输精管道通畅性及梗阻部位: Assesses vas deferens patency and obstruction site based on contrast medium visualization
map.输精管造影通畅性：按输精管、壶腹部、精囊、射精管是否显影判断；四段均显影为通畅；: Vasography patency: judged by whether the vas deferens, ampulla, seminal vesicle and ejaculatory duct are visualized; all four segments visualized means patent; ejaculatory duct not visualized or seminal vesicle visualized while ejaculatory duct obstructed suggests ejaculatory duct obstruction.
map.常为先天性或感染，可行显微吻合: Often congenital or infectious; microsurgical anastomosis possible
map.多为医源性损伤，可行端端吻合: Mostly iatrogenic injury; end-to-end anastomosis possible
map.可行经尿道射精管切开(TURED): Transurethral resection of ejaculatory duct (TURED) possible
map.先天性双侧输精管缺如(CBAVD)，查CFTR基因: Congenital bilateral absence of vas deferens (CBAVD), check CFTR gene
map.：精囊扩张 + 射精管不显影 + 低精液量/低pH/低果糖: : seminal vesicle dilation + ejaculatory duct not visualized + low semen volume / low pH / low fructose
map.：可见返流入膀胱，提示部分梗阻: : visible reflux into bladder, suggesting partial obstruction
map.：果糖(精囊)、中性α-葡糖苷酶(附睾)辅助定位: : fructose (seminal vesicle), neutral alpha-glucosidase (epididymis) aid localization
map.造影为侵入性检查，常在取精/再通手术时进行: Vasography is an invasive examination, usually performed during sperm retrieval / recanalization surgery
map.提示：造影结果需结合精液常规、精浆生化、阴囊彩超综合判断。仅供学习参考。: Tip: vasography results need comprehensive judgment with routine semen analysis, seminal plasma biochemistry and scrotal color Doppler. For learning reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：精道造影梗阻定位: 📚 In-Depth: Seminal Tract Angiography Obstruction Localization
map.输精管/精囊/射精管通畅判定。: Vas deferens / seminal vesicle / ejaculatory duct patency determination.
map.输精管、精囊、射精管均勾选通畅、部位 none → 精道通畅，不支持梗阻性无精子: Vas deferens, seminal vesicle and ejaculatory duct all checked patent, site none: seminal tract patent, does not support obstructive azoospermia.
map.部位=射精管、精囊明显扩张: Site = ejaculatory duct, seminal vesicle markedly dilated
map.射精管梗阻 + 精囊扩张 → 建议 TURED（经尿道射精管切开）评估。: Ejaculatory duct obstruction + seminal vesicle dilation: TURED (transurethral ejaculatory duct resection) evaluation recommended.
map.腹股沟段、盆段、射精管；射精管梗阻常伴精囊扩张、精液量少。: Inguinal segment, pelvic segment, ejaculatory duct; ejaculatory duct obstruction often accompanies seminal vesicle dilation and low semen volume.
map.定位明确后行显微/内镜重建或直取精+ICSI。: After clear localization, perform microsurgical / endoscopic reconstruction or direct sperm retrieval + ICSI.
